class _Unit<T extends num> extends Shape<T> {
  _Unit() : super(1 as T, label: 'unit');
  @override
  double get area => 1.0;
}

typedef Callback = void Function(int, [String? name]);

Stream<int> counter(int n) async* {
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    yield i;
  }
}

extension type Meters(double value) {}

final r = RegExp(r'^\d+$');
var hex = 0xFF + 1e3 + 1_000;
